name: jarryds-agents
description: Jarryd's personal, opinionated plugins, skills, and agents for agentic coding tools.

plugins.name: code-audit
plugins.description: Standalone evidence-backed changeset review with correctness, test, security, reuse, architecture and platform specialists; immutable Git scope, strict sensor/CI evidence, coverage-aware verdicts, private portable reports and process hypothesis packages.

plugins.name: open-source-auditor
plugins.description: Pre-publication open-source audit in one install: a specialist auditor persona plus nine skills - deterministic sensors (secrets, tone, quality, dependency, provenance, hygiene), a triaging PASS/BLOCK guardrail, Apache 2.0 licensing, and post-abort cleanup. Every run writes to an explicit, user-specified report folder.

plugins.name: repository-savior
plugins.description: Migrates archived Mercurial and SVN repositories into native Git and publishes them to GitHub as PRIVATE repositories only: an orchestrating persona plus fifteen pipeline skills - discovery, inspection, snapshot, conversion, normalization, publishability and integrity verification, mandatory pre-publication audit, private-only repository creation via a hardened gateway, independent privacy verification, push, fresh-clone proof, and reporting. Every run takes an explicit migration-root argument.

plugins.name: game-golden-screenshot-verifier
plugins.description: Engine-independent runtime game verifier using deterministic input, screenshots, and versioned goldens.

plugins.name: wpf-visual-quality-gate
plugins.description: Evaluator-run visual quality gate for WPF apps using real input and screenshot evidence.

plugins.name: skillz
plugins.description: Favorite miscellaneous skills in one plugin: commit-log for structured commit messages, grade for decisive letter grades, wtf for freeze-and-explain recovery, and chimp-out-report for finding operator frustration in local AI conversation archives.
